item.title: Version 1.3.25
item.description: Session Setup now works on any Mac with Pro Tools: the setup tool, its own Python and the Pro Tools helper come inside the app, so nothing else needs installing. The first time you press Setup Pro Tools Session, macOS asks you to allow ptui in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility. (Apple silicon Macs; the other tools work on Intel too.) Also: the Getting Started window mentions this in step 7.
